label.heading: Heading
tip.heading: Heading to enter in the game, in degrees: 0° = north, 90° = east, 180° = south, 270° = west.
tip.twa: TWA (True Wind Angle): angle between your heading and where the wind comes from. 0° = head to wind, 180° = dead downwind. Starboard or port = the side of the boat the wind hits.
tip.tws: TWS (True Wind Speed): strength of the true wind, in knots.
tip.probability: In how many of the 31 weather scenarios this option is the fastest. The higher, the safer the choice.
tip.confidence: Share of scenarios that put the boat in the same area at that time. It drops over time: the weather gets less certain.
